title: Reconstruct Original Digits From English
description:
Given a string s containing an out-of-order English representation of digits 0-9, return the digits in ascending order.

## Examples

```text
Example 1
Input: s = "owoztneoer"
Output: "012"
```

```text
Example 2
Input: s = "fviefuro"
Output: "45"
```

## Constraints

- 1 <= s.length <= 10^5
- s[i] is one of the characters ["e","g","f","i","h","o","n","s","r","u","t","w","v","x","z"].
- s is guaranteed to be valid.

The input is a shuffled concatenation of English digit names. Return the digits in ascending numeric order, preserving their multiplicities.
